desc: Establish monotonicity: binary search on target score is valid, with required visits \(r_i=\lceil x/\text{points}[i]\rceil\).
Prove the canonical left-to-right frontier traversal / greedy recurrence, including final-edge endpoint handling.
Exhaustively validate the threshold feasibility recurrence against BFS on tiny arrays, including uneven visit requirements, both possible final endpoints, and move limits.
Determine safe binary-search bounds and integer-safe ceiling division.
Implement `Solution.maxScore` with early termination when required moves exceed `m`.
Handle initial position \(-1\), boundary nodes, and insufficient move budgets.
